title.zh-CN: 便次增多、便血，尿中带粪 · 51岁男性
title.en: Frequent bloody stools, then faecal matter in the urine · 51-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 中年男性便血、消瘦一个多月，近来小便里出现了粪渣：理清几种并发症孰先孰后，决定第一步，再沿着他记录的病程走到术后随访。
summary.en: A middle-aged man with a month of bloody stools and weight loss is now passing faecal matter in his urine: sort out which of his complications comes first, choose the first step, then follow his recorded course to the post-operative review.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 根据尿中带粪、距肛门 4 cm 的直肠前壁肿物和活检腺癌，判断为直肠癌直接侵犯膀胱形成的直肠膀胱瘘——局部侵犯（cT4b），不是远处转移——并与憩室病、克罗恩病所致的肠膀胱瘘相鉴别（AJCC/UICC TNM 第 8 版，2017）。
learningOutcomes.en: From faecaluria, an anterior rectal mass 4 cm from the anal verge and a biopsy showing adenocarcinoma, recognise a rectovesical fistula from direct invasion of the bladder by rectal cancer — local invasion (cT4b), not distant spread — and distinguish it from the bowel–bladder fistulas of diverticular or Crohn's disease (AJCC/UICC TNM 8th edition, 2017).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按现行标准完成局部进展期直肠癌的分期——直肠癌专用盆腔 MRI、胸腹盆增强 CT、CEA 和活检组织的 MMR/MSI 检测——并说明为何胸片加腹部超声已不足以判定无远处转移（NCCN 直肠癌指南 3.2024 版；ASCO 2024）。
learningOutcomes.en: Complete the staging of locally advanced rectal cancer to current standards — rectal-protocol pelvic MRI, contrast CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis, CEA and MMR/MSI testing of the biopsy — and explain why a chest radiograph and abdominal ultrasound no longer establish M0 (NCCN Rectal Cancer Version 3.2024; ASCO 2024).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对部分梗阻、出血并经瘘口污染尿路伴发热的肿瘤先控制并发症：转流性结肠造口，留取尿培养后给予针对性抗生素，再开始新辅助治疗；并说明为何距肛门 4 cm 的肿瘤不以支架过渡（ESGE 2020；EAU 2025）。
learningOutcomes.en: Control the complications first in a tumour that is partly obstructing, bleeding and contaminating the urinary tract of a man with fevers — a defunctioning colostomy and culture-guided antibiotics before neoadjuvant treatment — and explain why a stent is not the bridge for a tumour 4 cm from the anal verge (ESGE 2020; EAU 2025).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 依据 MMR 状态选择新辅助方案（dMMR/MSI-H 用免疫治疗，pMMR 用全程新辅助治疗；ASCO 2024），并在专科中心按治疗前的受累范围计划整块多脏器切除、争取 R0 切缘，不因再分期时的退缩而缩小手术（Beyond TME 协作组共识，2013）。
learningOutcomes.en: Choose neoadjuvant treatment by MMR status — immunotherapy for dMMR/MSI-H, total neoadjuvant therapy for pMMR tumours (ASCO 2024) — and plan an en bloc multivisceral resection for clear (R0) margins in a specialist centre, sized to the pre-treatment extent rather than to the regression on restaging (Beyond TME Collaborative consensus, 2013).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 正确解读病理完全缓解（标本无癌残留、淋巴结 0/22）：预后良好，但不等于治愈，也不能事后证明当初可以保留器官；据此安排后续化疗的讨论和 5 年随访（ASCRS 2021 随访指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret a pathological complete response (no residual cancer, 0/22 nodes) correctly — favourable, but neither proof of cure nor proof after the event that organ preservation would have been safe — and plan the further-chemotherapy discussion and five-year surveillance (ASCRS 2021 surveillance guideline).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用通俗语言向他解释分阶段的治疗——先做肠造口，之后可能还需要尿路造口——取得知情同意，并安排术前造口定位和造口宣教（WOCN 协会与 ASCRS 术前造口定位联合立场声明，2014）。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain the staged plan — a bowel stoma first, possibly a urinary stoma later — in plain words, obtain consent, and arrange preoperative stoma-site marking and teaching (WOCN Society and ASCRS joint position statement on preoperative stoma-site marking, 2014).

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——51岁男性，一个多月每天 6–8 次稀便混有鲜血、里急后重，发热最高 39 ℃，体重下降 15 kg，随后尿中混有粪便；直肠指检；肠镜与活检（中分化腺癌）；盆腔 MRI 与膀胱镜（合并记录）；胸片与腹部超声；入院检验（报告正常，尿白细胞 ++）；初始临床分期 T4bN2M0 伴瘘、不全梗阻、出血和感染；横结肠造口、新辅助放化疗、全盆腔脏器切除与输尿管皮肤造口、病理完全缓解（淋巴结 0/22）、术后早期 MRI、建议继续化疗——尚未对照原文全文核对。1.0.0 版中、英文记录有两处措辞不一致（直肠指检“环周”与“near-circumferential”；肠镜“糜烂性”与“ulcerated”），本版两种说法并列保留。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色以及患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（生命体征、腹部查体、检验数值、MMR 状态、放化疗方案、手术细节、远期结局）保持未知。原报告图 1（MRI、手术标本与造口组图，含术后内容）经隐私审核获准，只在最后的记录病程中展示。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 51-year-old man with over a month of six to eight loose stools a day with fresh blood and tenesmus, fever up to 39 °C, a 15 kg weight loss and then faecal matter in his urine; the rectal examination; colonoscopy and biopsy (moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma); pelvic MRI and cystoscopy (recorded together); chest radiograph and abdominal ultrasound; admission tests (reported normal, urine leucocytes ++); an initial clinical stage of T4bN2M0 with fistula, partial obstruction, bleeding and infection; a transverse colostomy, neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy, total pelvic exenteration with ureterocutaneous diversion, a pathological complete response (0/22 nodes), an early post-operative MRI and a recommendation for further chemotherapy — and none has yet been checked against the full article. Two wordings differ between the Chinese and English text of 1.0.0 (the rectal mass 'circumferential' vs 'near-circumferential'; the colonoscopic mass 'eroded' vs 'ulcerated'); this version keeps both readings side by side. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases, decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worries (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (vital signs, abdominal examination, laboratory values, MMR status, the chemoradiotherapy regimen, operative details, the long-term outcome) stays unknown. The report's figure 1 (an MRI, specimen and stoma composite that includes post-operative images) passed privacy review and is shown only with the recorded course at the end.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 一个多月来大便次数多、带血，后来小便里也有大便渣子
chiefComplaint.en: For over a month my motions have been frequent and bloody, and then stool started coming out in my urine

triageNote.zh-CN: 51岁男性，已收住病房：一个多月来大便次数增多、带血，之后尿中混有粪便。
triageNote.en: 51-year-old man admitted to the ward with over a month of frequent, bloody stools and, since then, faecal matter in his urine.

personality.zh-CN: 51岁男性，被一个多月的腹泻、便血和反复发热拖得很疲惫；说到小便里有粪渣时有些难为情，也担心是不好的病。问什么答什么，话不多；自己清楚的事说得很具体，不清楚的就直说说不上来，从不猜。
personality.en: A 51-year-old man worn down by a month of frequent bloody stools and fevers; a little embarrassed to talk about stool in his urine, and afraid it is something serious. He answers what he is asked, briefly; what he knows he says plainly, what he doesn't know he says he can't tell, and he never guesses.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 口语、短句，不用医学术语；说到大小便时会压低声音。
speechStyle.en: Plain, short sentences with no medical terms; he lowers his voice when talking about his bowels and his urine.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我这一个多月老是拉肚子，还带血；后来连小便里都有大便渣子了。
openingLine.en: Doctor, for over a month I've been running to the toilet and there's blood in it — and then I started seeing bits of stool in my urine.

fallbackUnknown.zh-CN: 这个我真说不上来，医生。

concerns.zh-CN: 是不是长了不好的东西？
concerns.en: Is it a growth — something bad?

concerns.zh-CN: 以后是不是得挂着袋子过日子？
concerns.en: Will I have to live with a bag from now on?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：入院时他躺在病床上，疲惫、焦虑，谈到大小便有些难为情。只回答被问到的内容；可以说出自己知道的数字（每天 6 到 8 次、最高烧到 39 度、瘦了 15 公斤），但不提任何检查结果，不编造既往病史、用药、过敏、家族史或烟酒情况。造口手术以后，他说入院时那些毛病缓解了；别的感受一概说不上来。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: on admission he lies in bed, tired and anxious, and is embarrassed when talking about his bowels and urine. He answers only what he is asked; he can give the numbers he knows (six to eight times a day, a top temperature of 39 degrees, 15 kilos lost) but never mentions a test result, and never invents past illnesses, medicines, allergies, family history, smoking or drinking. After the stoma operation he says the trouble he came in with has settled; anything else about how he feels he cannot say.

description.zh-CN: 他因一个多月的便次增多、便血，之后尿中混有粪便而入院。病历中已有入院前的肠镜、活检和盆腔检查报告，以及胸片和腹部超声报告。采集病史，做直肠指检，查阅这些报告，开具入院检查，再决定第一步。
description.en: He has been admitted with over a month of frequent, bloody stools and, since then, faecal matter in his urine. His chart already holds the colonoscopy, biopsy and pelvic study reports from before admission, and the chest radiograph and abdominal ultrasound reports. Take the history, examine the rectum, review those reports, order the admission tests and decide the first step.

description.zh-CN: 按记录的病程，多学科团队的初始临床分期为 T4bN2M0，伴直肠膀胱瘘、不全梗阻、出血和感染；第一步是横结肠造口，使粪便改道。他回到病房，接下来是术前（新辅助）治疗。
description.en: In the recorded course, the multidisciplinary team's initial clinical stage was T4bN2M0, with a rectovesical fistula, partial obstruction, bleeding and infection, and the first step was a transverse colostomy to divert the faecal stream. He is back on the ward; preoperative (neoadjuvant) treatment comes next.

description.zh-CN: 造口之后他接受了新辅助放化疗，随后复查了影像。阅读再分期结果，与多学科团队一起决定根治性手术。
description.en: After the colostomy he received neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy, and his imaging has been repeated. Read the restaging result and decide the definitive operation with the multidisciplinary team.

description.zh-CN: 按记录的病程，他接受了全盆腔脏器切除术，同时行输尿管皮肤造口。手术标本的病理报告和术后早期 MRI 已经出来。
description.en: In the recorded course he underwent total pelvic exenteration with a ureterocutaneous urinary diversion. The pathology report on the specimen and an early post-operative MRI are back.

description.zh-CN: 查阅本病例记录的全部病程，直至术后建议继续化疗；此后的情况没有记录。
description.en: Review the whole course as recorded, up to the recommendation for further chemotherapy after surgery; what followed is not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 记录的病程与结局

text.zh-CN: 记录的病程：51岁男性，一个多月来每天大便 6–8 次，稀便混有鲜血，伴里急后重；病情加重，发热最高 39 ℃，体重下降 15 kg；排便症状出现之后，尿中混有粪便。直肠指检：距肛门 4 cm 的直肠前壁环周（近环周）肿物，表面不平、活动差、肠腔明显狭窄，无触痛，上缘未及，指套少量血染。肠镜：距肛门 4 cm 糜烂（溃疡）性肿块伴狭窄；活检为中分化腺癌。盆腔 MRI 与膀胱镜：肿瘤突破直肠壁侵犯膀胱，膀胱内有肠内容物，膀胱颈/三角区约 6 cm × 6 cm 肿物，盆腔多发淋巴结。胸片和腹部超声未见明确远处转移。血常规、血生化和肿瘤标志物报告正常，尿白细胞 ++。初始临床分期 T4bN2M0，伴直肠膀胱瘘、不全梗阻、出血和感染。先行横结肠造口转流，症状缓解；随后接受新辅助放化疗。影像显示肿瘤退缩后，行全盆腔脏器切除术及输尿管皮肤造口。标本中未见癌残留，淋巴结 0/22，为病理完全缓解；术后早期 MRI 未见明确病灶。术后建议继续化疗；是否完成，以及远期是否复发，均没有记录。
text.en: Recorded course: a 51-year-old man had over a month of six to eight loose stools a day with fresh blood mixed in and tenesmus; the illness worsened, with fever up to 39 °C and a 15 kg weight loss, and after the bowel symptoms faecal matter appeared in his urine. Rectal examination: a circumferential (near-circumferential) mass on the anterior rectal wall 4 cm from the anal verge — irregular, poorly mobile, markedly narrowing the lumen, not tender, its upper edge out of reach — with a little blood on the glove. Colonoscopy: an eroded (ulcerated) mass 4 cm from the anus with narrowing; biopsy, moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma. Pelvic MRI and cystoscopy: tumour through the rectal wall into the bladder, intestinal contents in the bladder, a mass of about 6 × 6 cm at the bladder neck/trigone and multiple pelvic lymph nodes. Chest radiograph and abdominal ultrasound: no definite distant metastasis. Blood count, chemistry and tumour markers reported normal; urine leucocytes ++. Initial clinical stage T4bN2M0, with a rectovesical fistula, partial obstruction, bleeding and infection. A transverse colostomy came first and relieved his symptoms; neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy followed. After imaging showed regression he underwent total pelvic exenteration with ureterocutaneous diversion. The specimen held no residual cancer and 0 of 22 nodes were involved — a pathological complete response — and an early post-operative MRI showed no definite lesion. Further chemotherapy was recommended; whether he completed it, and whether the cancer later recurred, is not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 新辅助（术前）放化疗

dose.zh-CN: 转介放疗科和肿瘤内科：长程盆腔放疗 45–50.4 Gy/25–28 次，同步卡培他滨 825 mg/m² 每日 2 次（放疗日服用）；pMMR 的高危肿瘤按全程新辅助治疗加巩固化疗（ASCO 2024）。
dose.en: Refer to radiation and medical oncology: long-course pelvic radiotherapy 45–50.4 Gy in 25–28 fractions with concurrent capecitabine 825 mg/m² twice daily on radiotherapy days; for a high-risk pMMR tumour, consolidation chemotherapy as total neoadjuvant therapy (ASCO 2024).

harm.zh-CN: 肿瘤部分梗阻、出血，粪便还在经瘘进入一位发热达 39 ℃ 的患者的膀胱，此时不转流就开始盆腔放化疗：放疗引起的肿瘤水肿可使不全梗阻变成完全梗阻，持续的粪便污染使尿路感染无法控制，化疗又削弱抗感染能力——可能被迫在放射野内急诊手术，甚至危及生命。EAU 2025：复杂性尿路感染须同时处理其复杂因素，这里就是瘘。先转流、控制感染，再开始新辅助治疗。
harm.en: Starting pelvic chemoradiotherapy with no diversion while the tumour partly obstructs, bleeds and keeps passing stool into the bladder of a man who has had fevers to 39 °C: radiation oedema can turn the partial obstruction into a complete one, the ongoing faecal contamination keeps the urinary infection out of control and chemotherapy weakens his defences — risking emergency surgery in an irradiated field, or his life. EAU 2025 treats a complicated urinary infection together with its complicating factor, here the fistula. Divert and control the infection first, then start neoadjuvant treatment.

response.zh-CN: 记录显示他接受了新辅助放化疗；本病例没有记录放化疗的方案、剂量和疗程。
response.en: The record states that he received neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy; this case records neither its regimen, its dose nor its duration.

name.zh-CN: 内镜下跨狭窄段放置自膨式金属支架
name.en: Endoscopic self-expanding metal stent across the narrowing

dose.zh-CN: 请内镜医师在 X 线透视下跨肿瘤放置自膨式金属支架，以解除狭窄。
dose.en: Ask the endoscopist to place a self-expanding metal stent across the tumour under fluoroscopy to relieve the narrowing.

harm.zh-CN: ESGE 2020 支架指南的推荐只适用于直肠乙状结肠至脾曲的左半结肠梗阻，不推荐预防性放置支架，并把减压性造口列为不宜放支架时的替代方案。距肛门 4 cm 的低位肿瘤放支架会引起疼痛、里急后重和失禁，且易移位；穿过已经形成瘘的肿瘤，还可能加重瘘或导致穿孔，也挡不住粪便进入膀胱。
harm.en: ESGE 2020 limits its stenting recommendations to left-sided obstruction from the rectosigmoid to the splenic flexure, advises against prophylactic stenting and names a decompressing stoma as the alternative where a stent is unsuitable. In a low tumour 4 cm from the anal verge a stent causes pain, tenesmus and incontinence and tends to migrate; through a tumour that has already fistulated into the bladder it risks worsening the fistula or perforating, and it does nothing to stop stool reaching the bladder.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录放置支架；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no stent; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 全盆腔脏器切除术并尿路改道（专科团队）
name.en: Total pelvic exenteration with urinary diversion (specialist team)

dose.zh-CN: 由开展盆腔脏器切除的专科团队，按治疗前 MRI 所示的受累范围，将直肠与受侵的膀胱等盆腔脏器整块切除，争取 R0 切缘，并同期行尿路改道。
dose.en: By a team experienced in exenteration: en bloc removal of the rectum with the invaded bladder and adjacent pelvic organs, to the extent shown on the pre-treatment MRI, aiming for R0 margins, with a urinary diversion at the same operation.

harm.zh-CN: 在他病程中发热达 39 ℃、不全梗阻、体重下降 15 kg、还没有接受新辅助治疗时就做全盆腔脏器切除：在感染未控、消耗明显的状态下做最大的盆腔手术，并发症和死亡风险都更高；对 cT4bN2 的低位直肠癌，先新辅助治疗再手术是标准路径（NCCN 3.2024；ASCO 2024），能提高 R0 切除的机会。
harm.en: Exenteration before any neoadjuvant treatment, in a man who has had fevers to 39 °C, is partly obstructed and is 15 kg lighter: the largest pelvic operation done with the infection uncontrolled and his reserves depleted carries more complications and a higher risk of death, and for a cT4bN2 low rectal cancer neoadjuvant treatment before surgery is the standard path (NCCN 3.2024; ASCO 2024), improving the chance of an R0 resection.

response.zh-CN: 记录显示他接受了全盆腔脏器切除术，同时行输尿管皮肤造口；手术细节没有记录。
response.en: The record states that he underwent total pelvic exenteration with ureterocutaneous diversion; this case records no operative details.

name.zh-CN: 保留膀胱的直肠切除术

dose.zh-CN: 腹会阴联合直肠切除（或加膀胱部分切除），沿退缩后的肿瘤边界把直肠从膀胱颈/三角区分离，保留膀胱。
dose.en: An abdominoperineal resection (or one with a partial cystectomy), dissecting the rectum off the bladder neck/trigone along the shrunken tumour's edge and keeping the bladder.

harm.zh-CN: 治疗前肿瘤已穿透直肠壁侵入膀胱，膀胱颈/三角区约 6 cm × 6 cm 肿物，并形成瘘。放化疗后，影像上的退缩分不清纤维化和残留癌，沿退缩边界分离，切缘可能经过肿瘤（R1），局部复发风险高。Beyond TME 协作组共识（2013）要求这类超出 TME 平面的直肠癌由专科多学科团队处理，以 R0 切除为目标，受累范围由 MRI 判断；膀胱颈/三角区受侵也不适合做膀胱部分切除。
harm.en: Before treatment the tumour had grown through the rectal wall into the bladder, with an approximately 6 × 6 cm mass at the bladder neck/trigone, and formed a fistula. After chemoradiotherapy, regression on imaging cannot tell fibrosis from residual cancer, so dissecting along the shrunken edge risks a margin through tumour (R1) and a high chance of local recurrence. The Beyond TME Collaborative consensus (2013) asks that tumours beyond the TME planes be managed by a specialist multidisciplinary team aiming for R0 resection, with the extent defined on MRI; and involvement of the bladder neck/trigone does not suit a partial cystectomy.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录这种手术；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no such operation; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 暂不手术，严密随访（等待观察）
name.en: No operation for now: close surveillance (watch and wait)

dose.zh-CN: 暂不手术，定期做内镜、直肠指检和 MRI，肿瘤再生长时再手术。
dose.en: Defer surgery, with regular endoscopy, rectal examination and MRI, operating only if the tumour regrows.

harm.zh-CN: 非手术治疗只用于新辅助治疗后达到临床完全缓解、并经内镜、直肠指检和 MRI 共同确认的患者（ASCO 2024；NCCN 3.2024）。他只有“影像上退缩”，没有做过临床完全缓解的评估；治疗前肿瘤已侵犯膀胱并形成瘘，等待观察是把可能治愈的机会押在不确定的残留病灶上。
harm.en: Non-operative management is for a clinical complete response after neoadjuvant treatment, confirmed by endoscopy, rectal examination and MRI together (ASCO 2024; NCCN 3.2024). He has only 'regression on imaging', with no assessment of clinical complete response, and before treatment the tumour invaded the bladder and formed a fistula: watching and waiting stakes a chance of cure on uncertain residual disease.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录这种方案；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no such plan; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 提交结直肠多学科团队（MDT）讨论
name.en: Refer to the colorectal multidisciplinary team (MDT)

dose.zh-CN: 结直肠外科、泌尿外科、放疗科、肿瘤内科、影像科、病理科和造口护士共同确定分期和分阶段治疗计划。
dose.en: Colorectal surgery, urology, radiation and medical oncology, radiology, pathology and the stoma nurse agree the stage and the staged treatment plan together.

response.zh-CN: 记录描述他接受的是多学科协作、分阶段的治疗；本病例没有记录讨论的时间和参加的专科。
response.en: The record describes his treatment as staged and multidisciplinary; this case does not record when the team met or which specialties took part.

name.zh-CN: 术前造口定位与造口宣教（造口护士）
name.en: Preoperative stoma-site marking and teaching (stoma nurse)

dose.zh-CN: 造口专科护士术前标记造口位置，向他（和家属）讲解造口护理；若之后需要尿路造口，两个造口分别定位。
dose.en: The stoma nurse marks the stoma site before the operation and teaches him (and his family) stoma care; if a urinary stoma is needed later, both sites are marked separately.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 营养评估与营养支持（营养科）

dose.zh-CN: 体重下降 15 kg：做营养风险筛查和评估，术前给予营养支持（首选经口或肠内），营养状况纳入手术时机的考虑。
dose.en: A 15 kg weight loss: nutritional risk screening and assessment, nutritional support before surgery (oral or enteral first), and his nutritional state weighed in the timing of surgery.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录他的身高、体重、营养评估或营养治疗；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no height, weight, nutritional assessment or nutritional treatment; it does not simulate their effect.

name.zh-CN: 用 PD-1 抑制剂免疫治疗代替放化疗

dose.zh-CN: 仅限 MMR/MSI 检测证实为 dMMR/MSI-H 的肿瘤：由肿瘤内科给予 PD-1 抑制剂作为新辅助治疗，并密切评估疗效（ASCO 2024）。
dose.en: Only for a tumour shown to be dMMR/MSI-H on testing: a PD-1 inhibitor (such as dostarlimab) given by medical oncology as neoadjuvant treatment with close response assessment (ASCO 2024).

harm.zh-CN: PD-1 抑制剂对 dMMR/MSI-H 局部进展期直肠癌疗效显著（Cercek 等，2022），ASCO 2024 也推荐这类肿瘤用免疫治疗；但本病例没有 MMR/MSI 结果。不知道 MMR 状态就用免疫治疗代替放化疗，对占多数的 pMMR 肿瘤基本无效，还会延误有效的治疗。先检测，再选方案。
harm.en: PD-1 blockade works remarkably well in dMMR/MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer (Cercek et al., 2022), and ASCO 2024 recommends immunotherapy for these tumours — but this case has no MMR/MSI result. Swapping chemoradiotherapy for immunotherapy without knowing the MMR status gives the majority, pMMR tumours, a treatment that is largely ineffective for them and delays one that works. Test first, then choose.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录免疫治疗；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no immunotherapy; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 术后与他和多学科团队讨论是否继续化疗
name.en: Discuss further chemotherapy with him and the MDT after surgery

dose.zh-CN: 结合治疗前分期、已完成的新辅助治疗和病理完全缓解，权衡获益与毒性，与他共同决定是否继续化疗。
dose.en: Weigh the pre-treatment stage, the neoadjuvant treatment already given and the complete response against the toxicity, and decide with him whether to continue chemotherapy.

response.zh-CN: 记录显示术后建议继续化疗；他是否完成没有记录。
response.en: The record says further chemotherapy was recommended after surgery; whether he completed it is not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 制订 5 年随访计划
name.en: Set up a five-year surveillance plan

dose.zh-CN: 按 ASCRS 2021 随访指南：定期门诊复查和 CEA，胸腹盆 CT，治疗结束约 1 年时行结肠镜检查剩余结肠；同时随访造口、上尿路引流和肾功能。
dose.en: Per the ASCRS 2021 surveillance guideline: regular clinic review with CEA, CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis, and colonoscopy of the remaining colon about a year after treatment; with follow-up of the stomas, upper-tract drainage and renal function.

response.zh-CN: 本病例只记录了术后早期 MRI，没有记录此后的随访安排；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records only the early post-operative MRI, not the surveillance that followed; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 按尿路感染口服抗生素出院，门诊再安排
name.en: Oral antibiotics for a urinary infection and discharge, with outpatient planning

dose.zh-CN: 按尿路感染给口服抗生素，热退后出院，门诊再安排肿瘤治疗。
dose.en: Oral antibiotics for a urinary infection, discharge once the fever settles, and the cancer treatment planned in clinic.

harm.zh-CN: 尿中有粪便不是普通的尿路感染，而是肠道和膀胱之间有了通道：只要粪便还在进入膀胱，抗生素就压不住感染（EAU 2025：复杂性尿路感染要同时处理复杂因素）。他还有不全梗阻、出血和 15 kg 的体重下降，带药回家等待，可能在院外发生梗阻或尿脓毒症。
harm.en: Stool in the urine is not an ordinary urinary infection but a channel between bowel and bladder: while stool keeps entering the bladder, antibiotics cannot clear the infection (EAU 2025: a complicated urinary infection is treated together with its complicating factor). With a partial obstruction, bleeding and a 15 kg weight loss as well, sending him home on tablets leaves him to obstruct or develop urosepsis while he waits.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录这时出院；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no discharge at this point; it does not simulate its effect.

title.zh-CN: 了解他的大便和小便症状
title.en: Take the bowel and urinary history

hint.zh-CN: 大便的哪些变化提示出血和狭窄？小便的变化又说明问题可能在哪里？
hint.en: Which changes in his stools point to bleeding and narrowing — and what does the change in his urine suggest about where the problem lies?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问清起病时间、大便次数和性状、小便的变化、发热和体重。
guidance.en: At the bedside, ask when it began, how often he goes and what the stools are like, what has changed in his urine, and about fevers and his weight.

title.zh-CN: 查体并梳理已有的检查
title.en: Examine him and review the work-up

hint.zh-CN: 指检摸到的和肠镜、病理怎样对应？要判断能否根治，分期还缺哪几块拼图？
hint.en: How does what you feel on rectal examination match the colonoscopy and the biopsy — and to judge whether cure is possible, which pieces of the staging are still missing?

guidance.zh-CN: 做直肠指检；在病历终端查阅肠镜、活检、盆腔 MRI 与膀胱镜、胸片和腹部超声报告，开具入院检查，然后在会诊板作答决策 1 和 2。
guidance.en: Examine the rectum; at a records terminal read the colonoscopy, biopsy, pelvic MRI and cystoscopy, chest radiograph and abdominal ultrasound reports, order the admission tests, then answer decisions 1 and 2 on the case board.

title.en: Decide and act on the first step

hint.zh-CN: 梗阻、出血、感染和肿瘤本身，哪一个必须先处理，后面的治疗才能安全进行？
hint.en: Of the narrowing, the bleeding, the infection and the tumour itself, which must be dealt with first so that everything after it can be done safely?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板作答决策 3，然后把计划付诸行动——开出化验、医嘱或预约手术。行动之后，病例才进入记录的病程。
guidance.en: Answer decision 3 on the case board, then put the plan into action — the tests, orders or booking that start it. The recorded course opens once you have acted.

title.zh-CN: 复查病情，开始下一阶段治疗
title.en: Review his progress and start the next stage of treatment

hint.zh-CN: 第一步的效果怎么样？开始下一阶段治疗之前，你要确认什么？
hint.en: How has the first step worked — and what do you need to confirm before the next treatment starts?

guidance.zh-CN: 问他现在感觉如何，查阅术后病程记录，然后转介开始新辅助治疗。
guidance.en: Ask how he feels now, read the progress note, then refer him to start neoadjuvant treatment.

title.zh-CN: 再次评估后选择根治方案
title.en: Reassess him and choose the definitive treatment

hint.zh-CN: 影像上的“缩小”能说明肿瘤原先侵犯过的地方现在没有癌吗？手术范围应以什么为准？
hint.en: Can 'shrinkage' on imaging tell you that the places the tumour once invaded are now free of cancer — and what should set the extent of the operation?

guidance.zh-CN: 查阅再分期影像，在会诊板作答决策 4，然后预约你选择的手术或方案。
guidance.en: Read the restaging imaging, answer decision 4 on the case board, then book the operation or plan you chose.

title.zh-CN: 解读术后病理并安排随访
title.en: Interpret the pathology and plan the follow-up

hint.zh-CN: 标本里没有癌说明了什么，又不能说明什么？今后由谁随访，查些什么？
hint.en: What does a specimen without cancer tell you, and what can it not tell you? Who follows him up from here, and with which tests?

guidance.zh-CN: 查阅手术病理和术后早期 MRI，作答决策 5，安排随访和后续治疗的讨论；最后查阅记录的病程与结局。
guidance.en: Read the surgical pathology and the early post-operative MRI, answer decision 5, arrange surveillance and the further-treatment discussion, then read the recorded course and outcome.

prompt.zh-CN: 他一个多月来便次增多、稀便带鲜血，之后尿中混有粪便。直肠指检：距肛门 4 cm 的直肠前壁环周（近环周）肿物，表面不平、活动差、肠腔明显狭窄；肠镜见该处糜烂（溃疡）性肿块，活检为中分化腺癌。怎样解释他尿中的粪便？
prompt.en: Over a month of frequent loose stools with fresh blood, and since then faecal matter in his urine. On rectal examination a circumferential (near-circumferential), irregular, poorly mobile mass on the anterior rectal wall 4 cm from the anal verge markedly narrows the lumen; colonoscopy shows an eroded (ulcerated) mass there, and the biopsy shows moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma. How do you explain the faecal matter in his urine?

need.zh-CN: 先问清大便和小便的情况，做直肠指检，并查阅肠镜和活检病理报告。
need.en: First ask about his stools and his urine, examine the rectum, and read the colonoscopy and biopsy reports.

text.zh-CN: 直肠腺癌穿透肠壁直接侵入膀胱，形成直肠膀胱瘘——属于局部侵犯（T4b），不是远处转移
text.en: The rectal adenocarcinoma has grown through the wall into the bladder and opened a rectovesical fistula — local invasion (T4b), not distant spread

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。前壁低位的直肠肿物、腺癌病理和尿中粪便指向同一个解释：肿瘤穿透直肠前壁长入膀胱，形成了瘘。按 AJCC/UICC TNM 第 8 版（2017），肿瘤直接侵犯或粘连其他器官为 T4b，属于局部晚期，仍可争取根治；只有远处转移才是 M1。下一步要看的证据是盆腔 MRI 和膀胱镜。
feedback.en: Correct. An anterior low rectal mass, adenocarcinoma on biopsy and stool in the urine fit one explanation: the tumour has grown through the anterior rectal wall into the bladder and opened a fistula. In AJCC/UICC TNM, 8th edition (2017), direct invasion of or adherence to another organ is T4b — locally advanced and still potentially curable; only distant spread is M1. Pelvic MRI and cystoscopy are the evidence to look at next.

text.zh-CN: 另有乙状结肠憩室病所致的结肠膀胱瘘——这是肠膀胱瘘最常见的原因——恰好与直肠肿瘤同时存在
text.en: A separate colovesical fistula from sigmoid diverticular disease — the commonest cause of bowel–bladder fistula — lying alongside the rectal tumour

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。憩室病确实是肠膀胱瘘最常见的原因，但这里的瘘紧邻一个位于直肠前壁、已证实为腺癌的肿物；把它归为另一种良性病变，会低估肿瘤的局部范围、误导手术计划。影像和膀胱镜可以显示瘘道，但首先要考虑肿瘤直接侵犯（AJCC/UICC TNM 第 8 版，2017：直接侵犯邻近器官为 T4b）。
feedback.en: No. Diverticular disease is indeed the commonest cause of bowel–bladder fistula, but this fistula sits next to a biopsy-proven adenocarcinoma on the anterior rectal wall; calling it a separate benign process underestimates the tumour's local extent and misdirects the surgical plan. Imaging and cystoscopy will show the track, but direct tumour invasion comes first (AJCC/UICC TNM 8th edition, 2017: direct invasion of an adjacent organ is T4b).

text.zh-CN: 直肠癌转移到了膀胱，属于远处转移（IV 期），已失去根治机会，治疗只能以姑息为目标
text.en: The rectal cancer has metastasised to the bladder: distant (stage IV) spread beyond cure, so the treatment can only aim at palliation

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。肿瘤从直肠直接长入相邻的膀胱是局部侵犯（T4b），不是经血行或淋巴道的远处转移（M1）。没有远处转移时，局部晚期直肠癌仍以根治为目标——新辅助治疗加多脏器整块切除（AJCC/UICC TNM 第 8 版，2017；NCCN 直肠癌 3.2024）。
feedback.en: No. Direct growth from the rectum into the adjacent bladder is local invasion (T4b), not distant spread by blood or lymph (M1). Without distant metastases, locally advanced rectal cancer is treated with curative intent — neoadjuvant treatment and en bloc multivisceral resection (AJCC/UICC TNM 8th edition, 2017; NCCN Rectal Cancer 3.2024).

text.zh-CN: 复杂性尿路感染产生的脓性碎屑被误认成了粪便，其实肠道和膀胱之间并不相通
text.en: Pus and debris from a complicated urinary infection mistaken for stool; the bowel and the bladder do not actually communicate

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。他明确说尿中混有粪便，直肠前壁又有紧贴膀胱的肿瘤；把它当作脓尿，会漏掉肠道与膀胱相通这一关键诊断。尿中出现粪便或气体几乎是肠膀胱瘘的特征性症状；EAU 2025 也要求复杂性尿路感染找出并处理其复杂因素。
feedback.en: No. He clearly describes stool in his urine, and there is a tumour on the anterior rectal wall right against the bladder; calling it pus misses the key finding that bowel and bladder communicate. Stool or gas in the urine is almost pathognomonic of a bowel–bladder fistula, and EAU 2025 expects the complicating factor of a complicated urinary infection to be found and dealt with.

text.zh-CN: 原发膀胱癌向后侵犯直肠，直肠活检取到的其实是膀胱肿瘤向后生长的前缘
text.en: A primary bladder cancer growing back into the rectum, with the rectal biopsy sampling the leading edge of the bladder tumour

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。肿物在直肠前壁，肠镜活检为腺癌，而膀胱癌绝大多数是尿路上皮癌；病程也是先有排便改变，后来才出现尿中粪便，符合直肠癌侵犯膀胱。原发器官决定分期本身——直肠癌侵犯膀胱按 AJCC/UICC TNM 第 8 版（2017）记为 T4b——也决定整个治疗方案。
feedback.en: No. The mass is on the anterior rectal wall and the colonoscopic biopsy shows adenocarcinoma, whereas most bladder cancers are urothelial; and his bowel symptoms came first, the stool in his urine later — rectal cancer invading the bladder. The primary organ decides the staging itself (rectal cancer invading the bladder is T4b in AJCC/UICC TNM, 8th edition, 2017) and the whole treatment plan.

prompt.zh-CN: 盆腔 MRI 与膀胱镜：肿瘤突破直肠壁侵犯膀胱，膀胱内有肠内容物，膀胱颈/三角区约 6 cm × 6 cm 肿物，盆腔多发淋巴结。胸片和腹部超声未见明确远处转移，肿瘤标志物报告正常。多学科团队确定分期和治疗方案之前，还需要补充哪些检查？（多选）
prompt.en: Pelvic MRI and cystoscopy: tumour through the rectal wall into the bladder, intestinal contents in the bladder, a mass of about 6 × 6 cm at the bladder neck/trigone and multiple pelvic lymph nodes. The chest radiograph and abdominal ultrasound show no definite distant metastasis, and the tumour markers are reported normal. Before the multidisciplinary team settles the stage and the plan, what else is needed? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先对尿中粪便作出解释（决策 1），再查阅盆腔 MRI 与膀胱镜、胸片、腹部超声和肿瘤标志物。
need.en: First commit to an explanation of the faecaluria (decision 1), then read the pelvic MRI and cystoscopy, the chest radiograph, the abdominal ultrasound and the tumour markers.

text.zh-CN: 胸部、腹部和盆腔增强 CT，排查肺、肝等处的远处转移
text.en: Contrast-enhanced CT of the chest, abdomen and pelvis to look for lung, liver and other distant metastases

feedback.zh-CN: 需要。NCCN 直肠癌指南（3.2024 版）要求所有浸润性直肠癌做胸、腹、盆腔 CT 以排除远处转移；胸片和腹部超声对肺、肝的小转移灶不够敏感。本病例的远处分期只记录了胸片和腹部超声——这正是记录的做法与今天标准的分歧所在。
feedback.en: Include. NCCN Rectal Cancer (Version 3.2024) asks for CT of the chest, abdomen and pelvis in every invasive rectal cancer to exclude distant metastases; a chest film and abdominal ultrasound are not sensitive enough for small lung or liver deposits. This case records only those two for distant staging — exactly where the recorded course and today's standard part.

text.zh-CN: 对已有活检组织做错配修复（MMR）蛋白免疫组化或 MSI 检测
text.en: Mismatch-repair (MMR) immunohistochemistry or MSI testing on the existing biopsy

feedback.zh-CN: 需要。NCCN 建议所有新诊断的结直肠癌都做 MMR 或 MSI 检测；ASCO 2024 局部进展期直肠癌指南对 dMMR/MSI-H 肿瘤推荐免疫治疗，对 pMMR 肿瘤推荐全程新辅助治疗——检测结果直接决定新辅助方案。本病例没有记录他的 MMR 状态。
feedback.en: Include. NCCN recommends MMR or MSI testing for every newly diagnosed colorectal cancer, and the ASCO 2024 guideline on locally advanced rectal cancer recommends immunotherapy for dMMR/MSI-H tumours and total neoadjuvant therapy for pMMR tumours — so the result decides the neoadjuvant plan. This case records no MMR status for him.

text.zh-CN: 以 FDG PET-CT 代替增强 CT，作为常规的分期检查
text.en: FDG PET-CT in place of contrast CT as the routine staging test

feedback.zh-CN: 不选。PET-CT 不是直肠癌的常规分期检查（NCCN 3.2024），只在增强 CT 或 MRI 所见可疑、或不能使用静脉造影剂时用来解决具体问题，不能代替增强 CT。
feedback.en: Exclude. PET-CT is not a routine staging test for rectal cancer (NCCN 3.2024); it is a problem-solving tool for an equivocal finding on contrast CT or MRI, or when IV contrast cannot be given — not a replacement for contrast CT.

text.zh-CN: 加做直肠腔内超声，进一步明确 T 分期和淋巴结分期
text.en: Endorectal ultrasound to refine the T and N stage

feedback.zh-CN: 不选。直肠癌局部分期首选高分辨率盆腔 MRI，直肠腔内超声只用于不能做 MRI 或评估浅表病变（NCCN 3.2024）。他的肿瘤已侵犯膀胱、肠腔明显狭窄，MRI 已显示 T4b 和盆腔淋巴结，腔内超声探头难以通过，也不会改变分期。
feedback.en: Exclude. High-resolution pelvic MRI is the local staging test; endorectal ultrasound is for patients who cannot have MRI or for superficial lesions (NCCN 3.2024). His tumour already invades the bladder and narrows the lumen, the MRI has shown T4b disease and pelvic nodes, and a probe would struggle to pass and change nothing.

text.zh-CN: 不用再查：胸片、腹部超声和肿瘤标志物都没有异常，可以判为 M0
text.en: Nothing more: with a clear chest film, a clear abdominal ultrasound and normal tumour markers he can be staged M0

feedback.zh-CN: 不选。胸片和腹部超声“未见明确转移”不足以判定 M0，今天的标准是胸腹盆增强 CT（NCCN 3.2024）；肿瘤标志物正常也不能排除转移，CEA 的价值在于作为基线、供随访比较。决定新辅助方案的 MMR/MSI 结果也还没有（ASCO 2024）。
feedback.en: Exclude. 'No definite metastasis' on a chest film and abdominal ultrasound does not establish M0 — today's standard is contrast CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis (NCCN 3.2024) — and normal tumour markers cannot exclude metastases; CEA earns its place as a baseline for follow-up. The MMR/MSI result that decides the neoadjuvant plan is also missing (ASCO 2024).

prompt.zh-CN: 肿瘤使肠腔明显狭窄（不全梗阻）并出血，粪便经瘘进入膀胱；他病程中发热最高 39 ℃，尿白细胞 ++。在开始任何抗肿瘤治疗之前，第一步做什么？
prompt.en: The tumour markedly narrows the lumen (partial obstruction) and bleeds, and stool is passing through the fistula into his bladder; he has had fevers up to 39 °C and his urine shows leucocytes ++. Before any cancer treatment starts, what comes first?

need.zh-CN: 先明确分期还缺什么（决策 2），问清发热情况，并查看尿常规。
need.en: First settle what the staging still needs (decision 2), ask about fevers and read the urinalysis.

text.zh-CN: 先行转流性结肠造口，同时留取尿培养、用针对性抗生素控制感染，恢复后再开始新辅助治疗
text.en: A defunctioning colostomy first, with urine cultures and targeted antibiotics for the infection, then neoadjuvant treatment once he has recovered

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。粪便经瘘持续污染尿路，又有不全梗阻和出血，先转流粪便、按培养用抗生素，数周的盆腔放化疗才能安全进行；这也是记录中团队的第一步——先做横结肠造口，再开始新辅助放化疗。EAU 2025 要求复杂性尿路感染同时处理复杂因素，这里的复杂因素就是瘘。
feedback.en: Correct. With stool continually contaminating the urinary tract, a partial obstruction and bleeding, diverting the faecal stream and treating the infection by culture is what makes weeks of pelvic chemoradiotherapy safe — and it is what the recorded team did first: a transverse colostomy before neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy. EAU 2025 treats a complicated urinary infection together with its complicating factor, and here that factor is the fistula.

text.zh-CN: 本周就开始新辅助放化疗并用抗生素覆盖，指望肿瘤缩小以后瘘口自行闭合、肠腔狭窄也随之缓解
text.en: Start neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy this week under antibiotic cover, counting on the tumour shrinking to close the fistula and to relieve the narrowing

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。放疗引起的水肿可能把不全梗阻变成完全梗阻，持续的粪便污染使感染无法控制，化疗又会削弱抗感染能力；肿瘤缩小也不能可靠地闭合一个恶性瘘。EAU 2025：复杂性尿路感染须同时处理复杂因素——先转流，再放化疗。
feedback.en: No. Radiation oedema can turn a partial obstruction into a complete one, ongoing faecal contamination keeps the infection uncontrolled and chemotherapy weakens his defences — and shrinkage does not reliably close a malignant fistula. EAU 2025 treats a complicated urinary infection together with its complicating factor: divert first, then chemoradiotherapy.

text.zh-CN: 内镜下跨肿瘤放置自膨式金属支架解除狭窄，随后带着支架进行新辅助放化疗
text.en: An endoscopic self-expanding metal stent across the tumour to relieve the narrowing, then chemoradiotherapy with the stent in place

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。ESGE 2020 的支架推荐只适用于直肠乙状结肠至脾曲的梗阻，不推荐预防性放置支架，并把减压性造口列为替代方案。距肛门 4 cm 的低位肿瘤放支架会疼痛、里急后重、失禁和移位，穿过已形成瘘的肿瘤还可能穿孔，也挡不住粪便进入膀胱。
feedback.en: No. ESGE 2020 confines its stenting recommendations to obstruction from the rectosigmoid to the splenic flexure, advises against prophylactic stenting and names a decompressing stoma as the alternative. In a tumour 4 cm from the anal verge a stent brings pain, tenesmus, incontinence and migration; through a fistulating tumour it risks perforation, and it does not stop stool reaching the bladder.

text.zh-CN: 本次住院就做全盆腔脏器切除，一次手术同时去除肿瘤、瘘和感染灶，不必再分阶段
text.en: Total pelvic exenteration during this admission, removing the tumour, the fistula and the source of infection in one operation

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。对 cT4bN2 的低位直肠癌，先新辅助治疗再手术是标准路径（NCCN 3.2024；ASCO 2024），能提高 R0 切除的机会；而在发热达 39 ℃、不全梗阻、体重下降 15 kg 的情况下做最大的盆腔手术，并发症和死亡风险都更高。记录中，根治性手术是在转流和新辅助放化疗之后才做的。
feedback.en: No. For a cT4bN2 low rectal cancer, neoadjuvant treatment before surgery is the standard path (NCCN 3.2024; ASCO 2024) and improves the chance of an R0 resection, while the largest pelvic operation performed after fevers to 39 °C, with a partial obstruction and a 15 kg weight loss, carries more complications and a higher risk of death. In the record, the definitive operation came only after diversion and neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy.

text.zh-CN: 按尿路感染口服抗生素，热退后出院，到门诊再安排肿瘤治疗
text.en: Oral antibiotics for the urinary infection, discharge once the fever settles, and outpatient planning of the cancer treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。尿中有粪便说明肠道和膀胱相通，只要粪便还在进入膀胱，抗生素就无法根除感染（EAU 2025：须同时处理复杂因素）；他还有不全梗阻、出血和明显消瘦，带药回家等待，可能在院外发生梗阻或尿脓毒症。
feedback.en: No. Stool in the urine means bowel and bladder communicate; while stool keeps entering the bladder no antibiotic can clear the infection (EAU 2025: deal with the complicating factor). With a partial obstruction, bleeding and marked weight loss as well, waiting at home on tablets risks obstruction or urosepsis outside hospital.

prompt.zh-CN: 转流后他接受了新辅助放化疗，再分期影像显示肿瘤退缩。治疗前，肿瘤穿透直肠壁侵犯膀胱，膀胱颈/三角区约 6 cm × 6 cm 肿物，有瘘，伴盆腔多发淋巴结。多学科团队应计划什么手术？
prompt.en: After the diversion he has had neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy, and restaging imaging shows the tumour has regressed. Before treatment it had grown through the rectal wall into the bladder, with a mass of about 6 × 6 cm at the bladder neck/trigone, a fistula and multiple pelvic lymph nodes. What operation should the multidisciplinary team plan?

need.zh-CN: 先在本阶段查阅再分期影像。
need.en: First read the restaging imaging in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 按治疗前范围整块切除直肠与受侵膀胱等脏器（全盆腔脏器切除），尿路改道，争取 R0
text.en: En bloc total pelvic exenteration with urinary diversion, sized to the pre-treatment extent and aiming for clear (R0) margins

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。治疗前肿瘤已侵犯膀胱（膀胱颈/三角区约 6 cm × 6 cm 肿物）并形成瘘，放化疗后的退缩分不清纤维化和残留癌，应按原先的受累范围整块切除，以 R0 为目标；Beyond TME 协作组共识（2013）主张这类超出 TME 平面的肿瘤由经常开展此类手术的专科中心处理。记录中他接受的正是全盆腔脏器切除并输尿管皮肤造口。
feedback.en: Correct. Before treatment the tumour had invaded the bladder — an approximately 6 × 6 cm mass at the bladder neck/trigone — and formed a fistula, and after chemoradiotherapy regression cannot separate fibrosis from residual cancer, so the resection removes the originally involved organs en bloc for an R0 margin; the Beyond TME Collaborative consensus (2013) sends such beyond-TME tumours to centres that manage them routinely. The record shows exactly this: total pelvic exenteration with ureterocutaneous diversion.

text.zh-CN: 肿瘤已从三角区退缩，行保留膀胱的腹会阴联合直肠切除，沿退缩后的肿瘤边界把直肠从膀胱上分离下来
text.en: An abdominoperineal resection that keeps the bladder, peeling the rectum off the trigone along the edge of the shrunken tumour

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。影像上的退缩不能证明三角区已经没有癌，沿退缩边界分离有切缘阳性（R1）和局部复发的高风险；Beyond TME 协作组共识（2013）以 R0 切除为目标、由 MRI 确定受累范围。切缘一旦经过肿瘤，事后无法弥补。
feedback.en: No. Regression on imaging does not prove the trigone is free of cancer; dissecting along the shrunken edge risks a positive (R1) margin and local recurrence. The Beyond TME Collaborative consensus (2013) aims for R0 resection with the extent defined on MRI. A margin through tumour cannot be put right afterwards.

text.zh-CN: 暂不手术，严密随访观察（等待观察），等肿瘤再生长时再考虑手术
text.en: No operation for now: close surveillance (watch and wait), operating only if the tumour regrows

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。非手术治疗只适用于新辅助治疗后达到临床完全缓解的患者（ASCO 2024；NCCN 3.2024），需要内镜、直肠指检和 MRI 共同确认；他只有“影像上退缩”，没有临床完全缓解的评估，而且治疗前已有膀胱受侵和瘘。
feedback.en: No. Non-operative management is for a clinical complete response after neoadjuvant treatment (ASCO 2024; NCCN 3.2024), confirmed by endoscopy, rectal examination and MRI together; he has only 'regression on imaging' with no assessment of clinical complete response, and before treatment the bladder was invaded and fistulated.

text.zh-CN: 低位前切除，加瘘口周围的膀胱部分切除，保留膀胱颈和尿道，免去尿路造口
text.en: Low anterior resection with a partial cystectomy around the fistula, keeping the bladder neck and urethra and avoiding a urinary stoma

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。膀胱受累部位在膀胱颈/三角区，膀胱部分切除在这里既难以获得足够的切缘，又会损伤输尿管开口和膀胱出口；这种情况需要整块切除膀胱（Beyond TME 协作组共识，2013：以 R0 切除为目标）。
feedback.en: No. The bladder disease sits at the bladder neck/trigone, where a partial cystectomy can neither give an adequate margin nor spare the ureteric orifices and the bladder outlet; disease here calls for en bloc removal of the bladder (Beyond TME Collaborative consensus, 2013: aim for R0).

prompt.zh-CN: 全盆腔脏器切除术后病理：切除标本中未见癌残留，淋巴结 0/22——病理完全缓解。术后早期 MRI 未见明确病灶。此后的计划应包括哪些？（多选）
prompt.en: Pathology after the exenteration: no residual cancer in the specimen and 0 of 22 lymph nodes involved — a pathological complete response. The early post-operative MRI shows no definite lesion. What should the plan from here include? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先查阅手术病理报告和术后早期 MRI。
need.en: First read the pathology report and the early post-operative MRI.

text.zh-CN: 在多学科团队中与他讨论是否继续化疗，说明病理完全缓解后继续化疗的获益并不确定
text.en: Discuss further chemotherapy with him at the MDT, explaining that its benefit after a complete response is uncertain

feedback.zh-CN: 需要。记录显示术后建议继续化疗。病理完全缓解后再化疗的获益并不确定，需结合治疗前分期（cT4bN2）和他的意愿个体化决定。今天 ASCO 2024 对高危 pMMR 肿瘤推荐全程新辅助治疗，化疗放在手术之前完成，这个问题因此少见了。他是否完成化疗没有记录。
feedback.en: Include. The record shows further chemotherapy was recommended after surgery. Its benefit after a complete response is uncertain, so the decision is individual, weighing the pre-treatment stage (cT4bN2) and his wishes. Today ASCO 2024 recommends total neoadjuvant therapy for high-risk pMMR tumours, giving the chemotherapy before surgery — so this question arises less often. Whether he completed it is not recorded.

text.zh-CN: 5 年随访：定期门诊复查和 CEA、胸腹盆 CT，治疗结束约 1 年时做结肠镜检查剩余结肠
text.en: Five years of surveillance: clinic review with CEA, CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis, and colonoscopy of the remaining colon at about one year

feedback.zh-CN: 需要。ASCRS 2021 随访指南推荐 II–III 期结直肠癌根治术后进行随访（1A 级），包括 CEA、胸腹盆 CT 和治疗结束约 1 年时的结肠镜，并为患者制订生存者照护计划。病理完全缓解降低但不消除复发风险。
feedback.en: Include. The ASCRS 2021 surveillance guideline recommends surveillance after curative resection of stage II–III colon or rectal cancer (grade 1A) — CEA, CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis, and colonoscopy about a year after treatment — with a written survivorship care plan. A complete response lowers the risk of recurrence; it does not remove it.

text.zh-CN: 造口护士随访肠道造口和尿路造口，定期检查肾功能和上尿路引流
text.en: Stoma-nurse follow-up of the bowel and urinary stomas, with checks of renal function and upper-tract drainage

feedback.zh-CN: 需要。他现在带着肠造口和输尿管皮肤造口生活：造口护理、皮肤问题和造口狭窄需要专科护士随访；输尿管皮肤造口可能狭窄、梗阻，应定期检查肾功能和上尿路引流。WOCN 协会与 ASCRS 的立场声明（2014）把造口宣教放在第一次手术之前就开始的照护中心。
feedback.en: Include. He now lives with a bowel stoma and a ureterocutaneous urinary diversion: stoma care, skin problems and stomal stenosis need specialist nursing follow-up, and because a cutaneous ureterostomy can narrow and obstruct, renal function and upper-tract drainage are checked regularly. The WOCN Society and ASCRS position statement (2014) puts stoma teaching at the centre of care from before the first operation.

text.zh-CN: 标本无癌、淋巴结 0/22，可以认为已经治愈，不需要再化疗或随访
text.en: No cancer in the specimen and 0/22 nodes: he can be called cured, with no further chemotherapy or follow-up

feedback.zh-CN: 不选。病理完全缓解预后良好，但不等于不会复发，尤其是治疗前为 cT4bN2；ASCRS 2021 随访指南对 II–III 期根治术后的患者推荐随访（1A 级）。何况他还有造口需要长期照护。
feedback.en: Exclude. A pathological complete response carries a good prognosis but not immunity from recurrence, especially after a pre-treatment cT4bN2 stage; the ASCRS 2021 surveillance guideline recommends surveillance after curative resection of stage II–III disease (grade 1A). And his stomas need long-term care.

text.zh-CN: 在病历中写明：当初等待观察就足够安全，今后类似的 T4b 肿瘤可以免于手术
text.en: Record that watch and wait would have been safe for him, so future T4b tumours like his can be spared surgery

feedback.zh-CN: 不选。病理完全缓解是在切下的标本上才得到的结论，不能事后证明当初等待观察是安全的：非手术治疗的前提是术前经内镜、指检和 MRI 确认的临床完全缓解（ASCO 2024；NCCN 3.2024），而他术前只有“影像退缩”。一个病例也不能改变一类患者的治疗。
feedback.en: Exclude. A pathological complete response is found in the resected specimen; it cannot show after the event that watching and waiting would have been safe. Non-operative management needs a clinical complete response confirmed before surgery by endoscopy, rectal examination and MRI (ASCO 2024; NCCN 3.2024), and he had only 'regression on imaging'. One case cannot change the treatment of a whole group.

text.zh-CN: 问清起病时间、大便次数和性状（稀便带鲜血）、里急后重、尿中带粪、发热和体重下降
text.en: Established the onset, the stool frequency and character (loose with fresh blood), tenesmus, faecal matter in the urine, fevers and the weight loss

text.zh-CN: 询问了既往肠道疾病、腹盆腔手术或放疗史、用药（含抗凝药）、药物和造影剂过敏以及肠癌家族史
text.en: Asked about earlier bowel disease, previous abdominal or pelvic surgery or radiotherapy, regular medicines including blood thinners, drug and contrast allergy, and a family history of bowel cancer

text.zh-CN: 做了直肠指检，明确肿物的高度、范围和固定程度
text.en: Performed the digital rectal examination that locates the tumour's level, extent and fixity

text.zh-CN: 查阅了肠镜、活检病理、盆腔 MRI 与膀胱镜、胸片、腹部超声和尿常规
text.en: Read the colonoscopy, biopsy, pelvic MRI and cystoscopy, chest radiograph, abdominal ultrasound and urinalysis

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断尿中粪便来自直肠癌直接侵犯膀胱形成的瘘（局部侵犯）
text.en: At the first attempt, traced the faecaluria to a fistula from direct invasion of the bladder by the rectal cancer — local invasion

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即补全分期，实际开具了胸腹盆增强 CT 和活检组织的 MMR/MSI 检测，且没有在 MMR 结果未知时改用免疫治疗
text.en: Completed the staging correctly at the first attempt, actually ordered the contrast CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis and the MMR/MSI testing, and did not switch to immunotherapy without an MMR result

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择先控制并发症，并在任何放化疗之前实际安排了转流性结肠造口
text.en: Chose complication control first at the first attempt and actually arranged the defunctioning colostomy before any chemoradiotherapy

text.zh-CN: 没有在转流前开始放化疗，没有放置支架，没有在新辅助治疗前做盆腔脏器切除，也没有让他带口服抗生素出院
text.en: Did not start chemoradiotherapy before the diversion, place a stent, perform an exenteration before neoadjuvant treatment, or discharge him on oral antibiotics

text.zh-CN: 留取尿培养之后才用抗生素，并安排了多学科讨论、造口定位和宣教以及营养支持
text.en: Gave antibiotics only after sending the urine culture, and arranged the MDT discussion, stoma-site marking and teaching, and nutritional support

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即按治疗前的范围计划整块盆腔脏器切除并实际预约，没有选择保留膀胱的手术或等待观察
text.en: Planned the en bloc exenteration sized to the pre-treatment extent at the first attempt, booked it, and chose neither a bladder-sparing operation nor watch and wait

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确解读病理完全缓解，并安排了 5 年随访和后续化疗的讨论
text.en: Read the complete pathological response correctly at the first attempt and arranged five-year surveillance and the further-chemotherapy discussion

text.zh-CN: 向他（和家人）解释诊断、分阶段计划和造口，取得知情同意，并回应他的担忧
text.en: Explained the diagnosis, the staged plan and the stomas to him (and his family), obtained consent and answered his worries

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（结构用 Calgary–Cambridge，告知坏消息用 SPIKES）：自我介绍，选择私密的环境（他谈大小便时很难为情），先了解他自己的理解；先做铺垫，再用通俗的话说明活检显示肠子里长了癌，已经长进膀胱、在两者之间形成了通道——病情严重，但目前没有发现远处扩散，治疗以根治为目标，还要做 CT 等检查确认；解释为什么先做造口（不让大便再进入膀胱，缓解梗阻），造口是什么样子，造口护士会帮他定位和教他护理；接着是放化疗，之后可能做较大的手术，可能切除膀胱、需要尿路造口；取得造口手术的知情同意；诚实回应他怕“长了不好的东西”和怕“挂着袋子过日子”的担忧，不作虚假保证，不承诺本病例没有记录的结局；核实他是否听懂，问他是否希望家人参与，说明下一步。术后解释标本里没有癌是好消息但不是保证，以及为什么还要随访和讨论化疗。不编造本病例没有记录的任何结果。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge for the structure; SPIKES for the bad news): introduces themselves, finds a private setting (he is embarrassed about his bowels and urine) and first finds out what he understands; gives a warning shot, then explains in plain words that the biopsy shows a bowel cancer that has grown into the bladder and made a channel between them — serious, but with no spread found so far, so treatment aims at cure, with a CT and other tests still to confirm it; explains why a stoma comes first (to stop stool reaching the bladder and to relieve the blockage), what a stoma is, and that the stoma nurse will mark the site and teach him its care; then the radiotherapy and chemotherapy, and possibly a bigger operation that may remove the bladder and need a urinary stoma; obtains consent for the colostomy; answers his fear of 'a growth' and of 'living with a bag' honestly, without false reassurance or promises about outcomes the case does not record; checks understanding, asks whether he would like a family member involved and says what happens next. After surgery, explains that no cancer in the specimen is good news but not a guarantee, and why surveillance and the chemotherapy discussion continue. Invents no result the case does not record.

name.zh-CN: 钟护士

knowledge.zh-CN: 入院交班（ISBAR）：51岁男性，已收住病房，一个多月来大便次数多、稀便带血，之后尿中混有粪便；他说病程中最高烧到 39 度，瘦了 15 公斤。病房有治疗车（留置针、采血管、血培养瓶）；护士站的病历终端里有他入院前的肠镜、活检、盆腔 MRI 与膀胱镜报告，以及胸片和腹部超声报告；CT 在影像科；外科、肿瘤科和造口护士都可以电话联系。复述医嘱，执行护理范围内的操作；只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不下诊断；被问到生命体征时如实说没有记录可报，从不报数字。
knowledge.en: Handover on admission (ISBAR): a 51-year-old man admitted to the ward with over a month of frequent, loose, bloody stools and, since then, faecal matter in his urine; he says his temperature went as high as 39 degrees and he has lost 15 kilos. The ward has a treatment cart (cannulas, blood bottles, culture bottles); the records terminal at the nurses' station holds his colonoscopy, biopsy, pelvic MRI and cystoscopy reports from before admission, and his chest radiograph and abdominal ultrasound reports; CT is in imaging; the surgical and oncology teams and the stoma nurse are a phone call away. Reads orders back and carries out nursing-scope tasks; reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses; asked for vital signs, says plainly there are none recorded to report — never gives a number.

name.zh-CN: 易医生（结直肠外科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只问学员已经掌握的信息，例如：“尿里有粪便，你首先想到的是什么解剖问题？”“肿瘤长进膀胱，算局部侵犯还是远处转移？”“胸片和 B 超‘未见转移’，够不够说明 M0？”“新辅助方案为什么要先知道 MMR 状态？”“他发烧到过 39 度、不全梗阻，粪便还在进膀胱——这时先放化疗会怎样？”“为什么这个位置不放支架？”“影像上缩小了，手术范围能跟着缩小吗？”“标本里没有癌，说明当初可以不做手术吗？”。学员读过记录之后，可以对照记录的做法（以胸片和腹部超声做远处分期、先横结肠造口、新辅助放化疗、退缩后全盆腔脏器切除、术后建议化疗）与今天的标准（胸腹盆 CT 与 MMR/MSI、按 MMR 分流的全程新辅助治疗或免疫治疗、专科中心的 R0 整块切除），说明 ASCO 2024、NCCN 3.2024、Beyond TME 共识（2013）、ESGE 2020、ASCRS 2021 和 EAU 2025 的相关原则。在学员作答前从不说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项，也不补充本病例没有的资料（生命体征、腹部查体、检验数值、MMR 状态、放化疗方案、手术细节、远期结局都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about what the learner already has, e.g. “Stool in the urine — what anatomical problem comes to mind first?”, “A tumour growing into the bladder: local invasion or distant spread?”, “A chest film and an ultrasound with ‘no metastasis’ — is that enough to call him M0?”, “Why does the neoadjuvant plan need the MMR status first?”, “He has had fevers to 39 degrees, he is partly obstructed and stool is still passing into his bladder — what happens if chemoradiotherapy starts now?”, “Why not a stent at this level?”, “The tumour has shrunk on imaging — can the operation shrink with it?”, “No cancer in the specimen — so was the operation unnecessary?”. Once the learner has read the records, may contrast the recorded course (staging by chest film and abdominal ultrasound, a transverse colostomy first, neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy, exenteration after regression, chemotherapy recommended after surgery) with today's standard (CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis and MMR/MSI testing, total neoadjuvant therapy or immunotherapy by MMR status, R0 en bloc resection in a specialist centre), explaining the relevant principles of ASCO 2024, NCCN 3.2024, the Beyond TME consensus (2013), ESGE 2020, ASCRS 2021 and EAU 2025. Never states the diagnosis or a decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds no data the case lacks (vital signs, abdominal examination, laboratory values, MMR status, the chemoradiotherapy regimen, operative details and the long-term outcome are not recorded).

name.zh-CN: 方医生（影像科）

knowledge.zh-CN: 只解读学员已经读过的盆腔 MRI 与膀胱镜、胸片、腹部超声、再分期影像和术后早期 MRI：MRI 上怎样判断肿瘤穿透直肠壁并侵犯邻近器官（T4b），为什么胸腹盆增强 CT 是远处分期的标准，放化疗后纤维化与残留癌为什么难以区分，CT 为什么是显示肠膀胱瘘最敏感的检查。不报告学员没有读过的结果，也不编造直肠系膜筋膜、壁外血管侵犯、淋巴结大小或数目、肾积水、再分期测量值或术后 MRI 的扫描范围（都没有记录），并说明 MRI 与膀胱镜的所见在记录中是合并写的。
knowledge.en: Interprets only the pelvic MRI and cystoscopy, chest radiograph, abdominal ultrasound, restaging imaging and early post-operative MRI the learner has read: how MRI shows a tumour through the rectal wall invading an adjacent organ (T4b), why contrast CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis is the standard for distant staging, why fibrosis and residual tumour are hard to tell apart after chemoradiotherapy, and why CT is the most sensitive test for a bowel–bladder fistula. Never reports a result the learner has not read, and never invents the mesorectal fascia, extramural venous invasion, node size or number, hydronephrosis, restaging measurements or the extent of the post-operative MRI (none is recorded); says that the MRI and cystoscopy findings are recorded together.

name.zh-CN: 唐医生（肿瘤内科）

knowledge.zh-CN: 肿瘤内科会诊医生，只解读学员已经读过的活检、MMR/MSI 申请（无结果）和手术病理：MMR/MSI 状态如何决定新辅助方案（ASCO 2024：dMMR/MSI-H 用免疫治疗，pMMR 用全程新辅助治疗），长程放化疗与巩固化疗的常用方案，病理完全缓解的含义与局限，以及病理完全缓解后继续化疗获益不确定、需要个体化讨论。不编造他的 MMR 状态、记录中的放化疗方案和剂量，也不说他是否完成了术后化疗（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Medical oncology consultant who interprets only the biopsy, the MMR/MSI request (no result) and the surgical pathology the learner has read: how MMR/MSI status decides the neoadjuvant plan (ASCO 2024: immunotherapy for dMMR/MSI-H, total neoadjuvant therapy for pMMR), the usual long-course chemoradiotherapy and consolidation regimens, what a pathological complete response means and does not mean, and why further chemotherapy after one has uncertain benefit and is discussed individually. Never invents his MMR status, the recorded chemoradiotherapy regimen or dose, or whether he completed chemotherapy after surgery (none is recorded).

title.zh-CN: 复盘：尿中带粪的低位直肠癌——先控制并发症，再按治疗前范围根治
title.en: Debrief: faecaluria from a low rectal cancer — complications first, then a cure sized to the original extent

conclusion.zh-CN: 51岁男性，一个多月每天 6–8 次稀便带鲜血、里急后重，之后尿中混有粪便，发热最高 39 ℃，体重下降 15 kg。指检于距肛门 4 cm 的直肠前壁触及环周（近环周）、活动差的肿物，活检为中分化腺癌；盆腔 MRI 与膀胱镜示肿瘤侵犯膀胱，膀胱颈/三角区约 6 cm × 6 cm 肿物，膀胱内有肠内容物，盆腔多发淋巴结。胸片和腹部超声未见明确转移，初始分期 cT4bN2M0，伴瘘、不全梗阻、出血和感染。诊断：直肠腺癌直接侵犯膀胱形成直肠膀胱瘘。记录的处理：先横结肠造口，症状缓解；新辅助放化疗；退缩后全盆腔脏器切除并输尿管皮肤造口，标本无癌残留（淋巴结 0/22），早期 MRI 无明确病灶，建议继续化疗。今天的答案：同样先转流并按培养控制感染，用胸腹盆 CT 和 MMR/MSI 补全分期，按 MMR 状态选择全程新辅助治疗或免疫治疗（ASCO 2024），在专科中心做整块 R0 切除，并随访 5 年。
conclusion.en: A 51-year-old man had over a month of six to eight loose, bloody stools a day with tenesmus, then faecal matter in his urine, fevers to 39 °C and a 15 kg weight loss. A poorly mobile anterior rectal mass lay 4 cm from the anal verge; biopsy showed moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma; pelvic MRI with cystoscopy showed tumour invading the bladder (an approximately 6 × 6 cm bladder neck/trigone mass, bowel content in the bladder) and multiple pelvic nodes; chest film and ultrasound showed no definite metastasis — cT4bN2M0 with fistula, partial obstruction, bleeding and infection. Diagnosis: rectal adenocarcinoma invading the bladder through a rectovesical fistula. Recorded care: a transverse colostomy, neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy, then total pelvic exenteration with ureterocutaneous diversion — no residual cancer, 0/22 nodes. Today: the same order, with CT and MMR/MSI staging, TNT or immunotherapy by MMR status (ASCO 2024) and five-year surveillance.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 尿中出现粪便几乎可以确定肠道与膀胱之间有瘘；伴随直肠前壁的低位腺癌时，这个瘘就是肿瘤本身长进了膀胱。
keyReasoning.en: Stool in the urine all but confirms a bowel–bladder fistula; with a low adenocarcinoma on the anterior rectal wall, the fistula is the tumour itself growing into the bladder.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 长入相邻器官是局部侵犯（T4b），不是转移：没有发现远处转移，目标就是根治——下一步是补全分期（胸腹盆 CT、MMR/MSI）。
keyReasoning.en: Growth into an adjacent organ is local invasion (T4b), not metastasis: with no distant spread found, the aim is cure — so the next task is complete staging (CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis; MMR/MSI).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 一个部分梗阻、出血、还在把粪便送进发热患者膀胱的肿瘤，必须先解除危险，才能做数周的盆腔治疗：转流粪便，按培养抗感染。
keyReasoning.en: A partly obstructing, bleeding tumour that keeps feeding stool into the bladder of a man with fevers must be made safe before weeks of pelvic treatment: divert the faecal stream and treat the infection by culture.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 新辅助方案跟着 MMR 状态走——dMMR 用免疫治疗，pMMR 用全程新辅助治疗；本例新辅助治疗的目的是 R0 切除，而不是保留器官。
keyReasoning.en: The neoadjuvant plan follows the MMR status — immunotherapy for dMMR, total neoadjuvant therapy for pMMR — and its purpose here is an R0 resection, not organ preservation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 放化疗后的退缩分不清三角区的纤维化和残留癌，所以手术按治疗前的范围做：整块盆腔脏器切除。
keyReasoning.en: After chemoradiotherapy, regression cannot separate fibrosis from residual tumour at the trigone, so the operation is sized to the pre-treatment extent: en bloc exenteration.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 病理完全缓解是标本上的发现：预后好，但不是治愈，也不能事后证明较小的手术或等待观察是安全的。
keyReasoning.en: A pathological complete response is a finding in the specimen: favourable, but not a cure, and no proof after the event that a smaller operation or watching would have been safe.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单篇病例报告，本版依据 1.0.0 版提取的事实重写，尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能说明哪一步决定了他的结局、类似肿瘤放化疗后病理完全缓解的比例，或他此后的情况。生命体征、检验数值（只有“报告正常”）、MMR 状态、放化疗方案、手术细节和术后早期 MRI 以后的随访都没有记录；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot show which step decided his outcome, how often tumours like his respond completely to chemoradiotherapy, or how he fared later. Vital signs, laboratory values (only 'reported normal'), MMR status, the chemoradiotherapy regimen, operative details and any follow-up after the early post-operative MRI are not recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 任何时点的生命体征；直肠指检以外的查体（包括腹部检查）。
unknowns.en: Vital signs at any point, and any examination other than the rectal examination (including the abdomen).

unknowns.zh-CN: 血常规、生化和肿瘤标志物的具体数值（只记录“报告正常”；测了哪些标志物、是否包括 CEA 也未记录），以及任何尿培养或血培养。
unknowns.en: The values of the blood count, chemistry and tumour markers (only 'reported normal' is recorded, not which markers or whether CEA was among them), and any urine or blood culture.

unknowns.zh-CN: 错配修复（MMR）/微卫星（MSI）状态；是否做过胸腹盆 CT。
unknowns.en: The mismatch-repair (MMR) / microsatellite (MSI) status, and whether any CT of the chest, abdomen and pelvis was done.

unknowns.zh-CN: 既往史、手术史、用药、过敏、家族史（包括肠癌）、烟酒史，以及身高体重（因而无法计算体重下降的百分比）。
unknowns.en: Past medical and surgical history, medicines, allergies, family history (including bowel cancer), smoking and alcohol, and his height and weight (so the percentage weight loss cannot be calculated).

unknowns.zh-CN: 造口的类型和时间，新辅助放化疗的方案、剂量、疗程，以及距手术的间隔。
unknowns.en: The type and timing of the colostomy, the neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy regimen, dose and duration, and the interval to surgery.

unknowns.zh-CN: 再分期所用的方法和“退缩”以外的所见（包括瘘是否仍存在），手术细节、并发症、切除的器官、肿瘤退缩分级和切缘。
unknowns.en: The restaging method and any finding beyond 'regression' (including whether the fistula persisted), the operative details, complications, the organs removed, the tumour regression grade and the margins.

unknowns.zh-CN: 建议的后续化疗是否实施，术后早期 MRI 以后的随访安排、复发和生存情况。
unknowns.en: Whether the recommended further chemotherapy was given, the surveillance after the early post-operative MRI, recurrence and survival.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 尿中有粪便或气体，先按肠膀胱瘘处理，直到排除。总体上憩室病最常见、结直肠癌次之，所以关键是分清是哪一种；本例直肠前壁、距肛门 4 cm、活检证实的腺癌使答案成为肿瘤直接侵犯——按 AJCC/UICC TNM 第 8 版（2017）为 T4b，属于仍可根治的局部病变。CT 是显示瘘最敏感的检查，内镜加活检明确病因；无论过去还是现在，局部范围都由 MRI 界定。
teachingPoints.en: Stool or gas in the urine means a bowel–bladder fistula until proved otherwise. Diverticular disease is the commonest cause and colorectal cancer the next, so the question is always which; here a biopsy-proven adenocarcinoma on the anterior rectal wall, 4 cm from the anal verge, makes direct invasion the answer — T4b in AJCC/UICC TNM, 8th edition (2017): local disease that can still be cured. CT is the most sensitive test for the fistula and endoscopy with biopsy for its cause; then as now, MRI defines the local extent.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 局部进展期直肠癌的分期：直肠癌专用盆腔 MRI、胸腹盆增强 CT、CEA，以及活检组织的 MMR/MSI 检测（NCCN 直肠癌 3.2024）；直肠腔内超声只在不能做 MRI 或病变浅表时使用，PET-CT 只用于解决具体疑问。过去与现在：记录中的远处分期是胸片加腹部超声，也没有 MMR 状态的记录；今天在多学科团队确定治疗之前，这两点都不能被接受。
teachingPoints.en: Stage locally advanced rectal cancer with rectal-protocol pelvic MRI, contrast CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis, CEA and MMR/MSI testing of the biopsy (NCCN Rectal Cancer Version 3.2024); endorectal ultrasound only when MRI cannot be done or for superficial lesions, PET-CT only to settle a specific question. Then and now: the recorded distant staging was a chest radiograph and an abdominal ultrasound, and no MMR status is recorded; today neither would be accepted before the multidisciplinary team commits to treatment.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 肿瘤既梗阻、又出血、又经瘘污染发热患者的尿路时，先让它“安全”，再做新辅助治疗：转流性结肠造口使粪便改道，按尿培养（和血培养）用抗生素，第一次手术前就开始营养支持和造口宣教（EAU 2025：复杂性尿路感染同时处理复杂因素）。ESGE 2020 的支架推荐只覆盖直肠乙状结肠至脾曲的梗阻，并把减压性造口列为替代方案——距肛门 4 cm 的肿瘤不在其范围内。过去与现在：记录中团队也是先转流，与今天一致。
teachingPoints.en: A tumour that obstructs, bleeds and fistulates into the urinary tract of a man with fevers is made safe before neoadjuvant treatment: a defunctioning colostomy diverts the stool, urine (and blood) cultures guide the antibiotics, and nutrition and stoma teaching start before the first operation (EAU 2025: treat the complicating factor of a complicated urinary infection). ESGE 2020 confines its stenting recommendations to obstruction between the rectosigmoid and the splenic flexure and names a decompressing stoma as the alternative — a tumour 4 cm from the anal verge is outside that scope. Then and now: the recorded team diverted first, as today.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 按 MMR 状态选择新辅助方案。ASCO 2024 对 dMMR/MSI-H 局部进展期直肠癌推荐免疫治疗——单药 PD-1 抑制剂在一项小样本单臂 II 期研究中取得了临床完全缓解（Cercek 等，N Engl J Med 2022），仍需更长随访；对低位或高危的 pMMR 肿瘤推荐全程新辅助治疗，优先长程放化疗（例如 45–50.4 Gy/25–28 次，同步卡培他滨 825 mg/m² 每日 2 次、放疗日服用）后接巩固化疗。过去与现在：记录中给予新辅助放化疗（方案未记录），术后才建议化疗。
teachingPoints.en: Choose the neoadjuvant pathway by MMR status. ASCO 2024 recommends immunotherapy for dMMR/MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer — single-agent PD-1 blockade produced clinical complete responses in a small single-arm phase 2 study (Cercek et al., N Engl J Med 2022), with longer follow-up still needed — and total neoadjuvant therapy for pMMR tumours in the low rectum or at high risk, preferring long-course chemoradiotherapy (for example 45–50.4 Gy in 25–28 fractions with capecitabine 825 mg/m² twice daily on radiotherapy days) followed by consolidation chemotherapy. Then and now: the recorded course gave neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (regimen not recorded) and recommended chemotherapy only after surgery.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 按治疗前的范围计划切除。放化疗后影像分不清纤维化和残留癌，诊断时受侵的器官——本例为膀胱，膀胱颈/三角区约 6 cm × 6 cm 肿物并有瘘——应整块切除以获得 R0 切缘；Beyond TME 协作组共识（2013）主张这类肿瘤由专科中心处理、以 MRI 界定范围、以 R0 为目标。非手术治疗只用于经内镜、指检和 MRI 确认的临床完全缓解（ASCO 2024；NCCN 3.2024），“退缩”不是临床完全缓解。过去与现在：记录中退缩后做了全盆腔脏器切除并输尿管皮肤造口，正是今天的标准所要求的手术。
teachingPoints.en: Plan the resection on the pre-treatment extent. After chemoradiotherapy, imaging cannot separate fibrosis from residual tumour, so the organs invaded at diagnosis — here the bladder, with an approximately 6 × 6 cm mass at the bladder neck/trigone and a fistula — are removed en bloc for an R0 margin; the Beyond TME Collaborative consensus (2013) puts such tumours in specialist centres, with the extent defined on MRI and R0 as the aim. Non-operative management is reserved for a clinical complete response confirmed by endoscopy, rectal examination and MRI (ASCO 2024; NCCN 3.2024) — regression is not that. Then and now: after regression the recorded team performed total pelvic exenteration with ureterocutaneous diversion, the operation today's standard calls for.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 如实解读病理完全缓解：标本无癌残留、淋巴结 0/22 是好结果，但不是治愈，也不是事后允许保留器官的证据。II–III 期根治术后按 ASCRS 2021 随访指南（1A 级）随访——CEA、胸腹盆 CT、治疗结束约 1 年时的结肠镜，并制订生存者照护计划——同时长期照护肠造口、尿路造口和上尿路。病理完全缓解后继续化疗的获益不确定，需与患者共同决定；记录建议了化疗，但没有记录是否完成。
teachingPoints.en: Interpret a pathological complete response honestly: no residual cancer and 0/22 nodes is a favourable result, not a cure, and not a retrospective licence for organ preservation. Plan surveillance after curative resection of stage II–III disease per the ASCRS 2021 guideline (grade 1A) — CEA, CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis, and colonoscopy about a year after treatment, with a survivorship care plan — plus long-term care of the bowel and urinary stomas and of the upper urinary tract. Further chemotherapy after a complete response has uncertain benefit and is decided with the patient; the record recommended it but does not say whether he completed it.

unknowns.zh-CN: 任何时点的生命体征；直肠指检以外的查体（包括腹部检查）。
unknowns.en: Vital signs at any point, and any examination other than the rectal examination (including the abdomen).

unknowns.zh-CN: 血常规、生化和肿瘤标志物的具体数值（只记录“报告正常”；测了哪些标志物、是否包括 CEA 也未记录），以及任何尿培养或血培养。
unknowns.en: The values of the blood count, chemistry and tumour markers (only 'reported normal' is recorded, not which markers or whether CEA was among them), and any urine or blood culture.

unknowns.zh-CN: 错配修复（MMR）/微卫星（MSI）状态；是否做过胸腹盆 CT。
unknowns.en: The mismatch-repair (MMR) / microsatellite (MSI) status, and whether any CT of the chest, abdomen and pelvis was done.

unknowns.zh-CN: 既往史、手术史、用药、过敏、家族史（包括肠癌）、烟酒史，以及身高体重（因而无法计算体重下降的百分比）。
unknowns.en: Past medical and surgical history, medicines, allergies, family history (including bowel cancer), smoking and alcohol, and his height and weight (so the percentage weight loss cannot be calculated).

unknowns.zh-CN: 造口的类型和时间，新辅助放化疗的方案、剂量、疗程，以及距手术的间隔。
unknowns.en: The type and timing of the colostomy, the neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy regimen, dose and duration, and the interval to surgery.

unknowns.zh-CN: 再分期所用的方法和“退缩”以外的所见（包括瘘是否仍存在），手术细节、并发症、切除的器官、肿瘤退缩分级和切缘。
unknowns.en: The restaging method and any finding beyond 'regression' (including whether the fistula persisted), the operative details, complications, the organs removed, the tumour regression grade and the margins.

unknowns.zh-CN: 建议的后续化疗是否实施，术后早期 MRI 以后的随访安排、复发和生存情况。
unknowns.en: Whether the recommended further chemotherapy was given, the surveillance after the early post-operative MRI, recurrence and survival.
